name: litigation-workbench
description: Five record-based workflows for business litigation, from a proof matrix to a brief audit.

interface.longDescription: Build a proof matrix, prepare an exhibit-linked deposition, reconcile a demand, design a Lexis research assignment, or audit a brief. Works with the sources the attorney supplies. The plugin contains written workflows and adds no external connections.
defaultPrompt: Build a proof matrix for the disputed propositions in the attached documents.
Reconcile this demand to the ledger and identify any unsupported payment triggers.
Audit this draft against the supplied authorities. Show the weakest proposition and its pinpoint.
